raw_response:
This sorghum plot is small, and here in Tigray I have to be careful with cash because rainfall can be uncertain. I will use a modest amount of chemical fertilizer and some manure, but I will keep using my local sorghum seed because it handles our conditions better. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will rely mostly on my family for the work, with only a little hired help if needed at weeding or harvest.
